note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. All poured copper on this board stops 0.55 mm short of the edge. Tabs stay off the gold shutter, the switch knob (left edge, y 113..125), and the parts near the right edge (y 105..122).

tabs.why: middle of the top edge, where the cell slides in (the nub is in the board's plane, under the cell's edge)
left edge, between the corner hole and the maker's logo
right edge, beside the board-name lettering, above the EEPROMs
bottom edge, left of the shutter, right of the cut corner
bottom edge, right of the shutter
